paite: Aw tangte na maa a luan khiak zoizoina ding un, van botkekin hongkum suk teitei lechin aw.
english: Oh that you would tear the heavens, that you would come down, that the mountains might quake at your presence,

paite: Nam chih na maa a linna ding un nang hondoute kianga na min theihsak nadingin, meiin sing neen a kuangsaka, meiin tui a sousak bangin!
english: as when fire kindles the brushwood, and the fire causes the waters to boil; to make your name known to your adversaries, that the nations may tremble at your presence!

paite: Ka lamet louh uh thil mulkimhuai na hih laiin na hong suka, tangte maah a luangkhe zoizoi uhi.
english: When you did awesome things which we didn’t look for, you came down, the mountains quaked at your presence.

paite: Nidanglaia kipanin miten, nangkia loungal, amaute ngak dinga, sepsak jelpa Pathian lah a thei ngeikei ua, bilin lah a za ngei kei ua, mitin leng a mu ngei sam kei hi.
english: For from of old men have not heard, nor perceived by the ear, neither has the eye seen a God besides you, who works for him who waits for him.

paite: Nang jaw, nuam taka oma diktat taka hihmi, na lampitea nang hontheigigete, na don jela; ngaiin, nang na hihiam, kou thil ka hihkhial ua; huaite-ah sawtpi ka naomta ua, huchiin hotdamin ka om thei lai ding uam?
english: You meet him who rejoices and works righteousness, those who remember you in your ways. Behold, you were angry, and we sinned. We have been in sin for a long time; and shall we be saved?

paite: Mi nin bangin kana om vekta ngal ua, ka diktatna teng uh leng puansilh nin bang ahi: ka vek un nah bangin ka vuai ua; ka thulimlouhnate un huih bangin a honmut mang jel hi.
english: For we have all become as one who is unclean, and all our righteousness is as a polluted garment: and we all fade as a leaf; and our iniquities, like the wind, take us away.

paite: Huchiin na min lou-a, nang honlen dinga kihihhalh kuamah himhim a om kei uh: kou akipanin na mai na selta ngala, ka thulimlouhnate uh zangin non mangsakta hi.
english: There is none who calls on your name, who stirs up himself to take hold of you; for you have hidden your face from us, and have consumed us by means of our iniquities.

paite: Tuin jaw, aw TOUPA, nang ka pa uh na hi; kou bellei ka hi ua; nang kou honvelpa na hi; huchiin ka vek un na khut suak ka hi uh.
english: But now, Yahweh, you are our Father; we are the clay, and you our potter; and we all are the work of your hand.

paite: TOUPA aw, heh lo kenla, thulimlouhnate leng khantawnin theigige sam ken: ngaiin hehpihtakin hon en inla, ka vek un nangmah mite ka hi uhi.
english: Don’t be furious, Yahweh, neither remember iniquity forever: see, look, we beg you, we are all your people.

paite: Na khopi siangthoute gamdai a hong suak ua, Zion lah gamdai a hong suak a, Jerusalem lah mun nawtsiat a hong hita hi.
english: Your holy cities are become a wilderness, Zion has become a wilderness, Jerusalem a desolation.

paite: Ka in siangthou uleh ka in kilawm tak uh, ka pipute un nang a honna phat jelna uh, meia hal ahi; ka thil deihhuaite tengteng ulah hihsiatin a omvekta ngala.TOUPA aw, huai thilte-ah na kidek thei sin ahia? Na dai nilouhin non hihgenthei nilouh sin ahia?
english: Our holy and our beautiful house, where our fathers praised you, is burned with fire; and all our pleasant places are laid waste.

paite: TOUPA aw, huai thilte-ah na kidek thei sin ahia? Na dai nilouhin non hihgenthei nilouh sin ahia?
english: Will you refrain yourself for these things, Yahweh? Will you hold your peace, and afflict us very severely?
